description: Markov-trace assembly chain for the deuteron: combines the 11 schur-weyl-weight-{6, 51, 42, 411, 33, 321, 3111, 222, 2211, 21111, 111111} per-λ chains + the canonical atomic-braid recipe for β_D (23 crossings) + the per-irrep characters χ^λ_q(β_D) via the Hoefsmit recipe (cached in chi-deuteron-h6.witness.json) via the finite-Jones axiom into tr_M(D, q_0) ≈ 0.17744.  Trust profile is {axiom: 1, mathlib-cited: 0, derived: 3, script-cited: 1, computational: 1} — closes the per-λ Wedderburn-weight frontier for n=6 (all 11 weights now DERIVED via dedicated chains, replacing what would otherwise be 11 SCRIPT_CITED weight steps).  The remaining SCRIPT_CITED step is only the per-irrep χ^λ values (pending per-(λ, σ_i) Hoefsmit chains for n=6, analogous to the existing hoefsmit-rep-21-{sigma1,sigma2} chains for n=3) — the β_D recipe step now references atomic-braid-recipe-d.derivation.json.  Companion to markov-trace-assembly-{proton,neutron}.derivation.json.

steps.name: Partitions of 6 — Schur–Weyl basis at A=2
steps.operation: By Schur–Weyl duality the n=3·A=6 ambient Hecke algebra is H_6(q); partitions of 6 enumerate the Wedderburn blocks.  There are 11 partitions (counted by p(6)=11), with Wedderburn block dimensions f_λ given by the hook-length formula.

steps.name: Wedderburn weights w_λ(q) for λ ⊢ 6 — chain references
steps.operation: Reference the 11 dedicated per-λ chains `schur-weyl-weight-{6, 51, 42, 411, 33, 321, 3111, 222, 2211, 21111, 111111}.derivation.json`.  All 11 use the Hoefsmit normalisation w_λ(q) = (q − q^{-1})^(n − l(λ)) · ∏_x [h_x]_q^{-1} (matching the schur-weyl-weight-3 convention on the proton/neutron chains) and are themselves fully-trusted (each has profile {axiom: 1, mathlib-cited: 2, derived: 1}).
steps.notes: Derivation chains: schur-weyl-weight-{6, 51, 42, 411, 33, 321, 3111, 222, 2211, 21111, 111111}.derivation.json (11 chains, all shipped on main as part of the per-λ frontier paydown for partitions of 4-9).  Each chain discharges its w_λ(q) value entirely from AXIOMs (Hecke energy + Wedderburn + Schur).

steps.name: Atomic-braid recipe for β_D — chain reference
steps.operation: Reference `atomic-braid-recipe-d.derivation.json`: β_D is the canonical 23-crossing σ-word for the deuteron, derived by composing atomic-braid-recipe-{p,n}.derivation.json + 1 inter-nucleon mixed crossing at σ_2.  Type breakdown {σ: 11, σ^{-1}: 7, averaged: 5}.  Matches `canonical_braid_crossings.atom_canonical_crossings(Z=1, N=1, include_inter=True)`.
steps.output_value: β_D = canonical σ-word of length 23 (11 σ + 7 σ^{-1} + 5 averaged)
steps.notes: Derivation chain: atomic-braid-recipe-d.derivation.json (builder: build_atomic_braid_recipe_d_chain.py).  Fully-trusted with profile {axiom: 1, derived: 3, computational: 1}.  Discharges this step's SCRIPT_CITED frontier.

steps.name: Per-irrep characters χ^λ_q(β_D) via Hoefsmit recipe
steps.operation:
For each λ ⊢ 6, compute χ^λ_q(β_D) by applying the Hoefsmit matrix recipe to the σ-word β_D: ρ^λ(σ_i) is the Hoefsmit matrix in the SYT basis of λ, ρ^λ(σ_i^{-1}) follows from the Hecke relation σ_i^2 = (q − q^{-1}) σ_i + 1 (so σ_i^{-1} = σ_i − (q − q^{-1})), and ρ^λ(I_avg) = ρ^λ(σ_i) − (q − q^{-1})/2 · 1.  The character χ^λ_q(β_D) is the trace of the resulting f_λ × f_λ matrix product over all 23 crossings.
Closed-form values are cached in `chi-deuteron-h6.witness.json` (compute time ~155 s first-run, O(1) on cache hits).
steps.output_value: χ^λ_q(β_D) for each of the 11 partitions of 6, as symbolic Laurent polynomials in q (see chi-deuteron-h6.witness.json `chi_lambda_symbolic` field)
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/hecke/hecke_character_symbolic.py function `q_character_on_braid_word(λ, β_D, q)` (called 11 times, once per partition of 6).  Cache: chi-deuteron-h6.witness.json.  SCRIPT_CITED until per-(λ, σ_i) Hoefsmit chains for n=6 ship (analogous to the existing hoefsmit-rep-21-{sigma1,sigma2} chains for n=3, but specialised to the partitions of 6).  Trivial and sign reps have closed-form expressions in (n_+, n_-, n_avg) and could be promoted to DERIVED in a follow-up.

steps.name: Finite-Jones Markov-trace assembly
steps.operation: tr_M(β_D, q) = Σ_{λ ⊢ 6} w_λ(q) · χ^λ_q(β_D), summing over all 11 partitions of 6.  Uniqueness from finite-Jones (the Markov trace is the unique linear functional on H_6(q) satisfying τ(1)=1, τ(σ_i)=z, τ(xy)=τ(yx), τ(x σ_n)=z·τ(x); the Schur-Weyl decomposition into Wedderburn blocks gives the explicit formula above).

steps.name: Evaluate tr_M(D, q_0) at q_0
steps.operation: Substitute q := q_0 = 1.10997... into the symbolic assembly; mpmath at 50 dps gives 0.17743692421543206... matching the upstream atom-tr-M-q0 chain leaf (D-tr-M-q0.derivation.json target_value) and the habiro-coefficients-atomic.witness.json D entry tr_M_at_q0 field.
steps.notes: Cross-checked at machine precision against the upstream habiro_coefficients_atomic.py / habiro-coefficients-atomic witness for the deuteron (Z=1, N=1, include_inter=True) — rel_diff ≤ 1e-12 against that script's `tr_M_at_q0` field.
